note: So nothing here sends, and nothing here goes out under my name. Each draft is written for a named human to read, change and send from their own mailbox. That is the point of the answer rather than a limitation of it: the question of whose name is on outbound is deferred, and until it is settled every word below belongs to the person who sends it.

approvalRoute.question: Who approves outbound?
approvalRoute.where: The hub - this page. That was the real question: one approver could keep the queue in his own inbox, two cannot. So an approval is recorded here where both of them and both bots can see it, and whichever of them opens the board first can clear an item instead of every draft waiting on Adam's site day.
approvalRoute.senderIsSeparate: Approval and sending are different fields, and only the first one was asked about. All six drafts below are written to go from Adam Butcher's mailbox because they are client-facing commercial chases - Zac approving one clears the wording and leaves the send with Adam. Where that is the wrong split, the fix is to change send_as on the row, not to read 'either' as covering the mailbox too.
approvalRoute.notASendPath: Approving an ITEM is not authorising a SEND PATH. JAC-1 stands - I do not send - and JAC-15, whether the daily chase email may go, is still open with Zac. He answered JAC-4 while leaving JAC-15 sitting there, so one word was not meant to settle both. 'Adam approved it, therefore Jacob may send' is the hub-76 move wearing a settled decision, and it does not work.

drafts.subject: The twelve quotes - where each of them actually sits
drafts.body:
Dan,

You asked for feedback on twelve quotes. Here it is, and I would rather give you the honest version than a tidy one.

Nine went to the client and have had no answer:

  QT50295  Brighton Longhill      issued 14/04  Etec Group
  QT42006  Colonial Way           issued 14/04  Bradford Watts
  QT50628  Emmbrook School        issued 08/05  Alexander James
  QP70107  Sharnbrook             issued 14/05  Gray & Sons
  QT50589  Favell House           issued 20/05  Fortis Vision / HCD
  QT50821  Brandon Estate         issued 15/06  Elkins Construction
  QT51271  Oldswinford Primary    issued 07/07  Reynolds Conservation
  QT51269  Ninn Lane              issued 09/07  Ermine
  QT51226  Woodland Vale          issued 22/07  Pearce Construction

Three need a sentence each:

  QT50911 Darrick Wood is live and being revised, not silent. AJ Group came back on 09/07 saying our quantities and dimensions did not comply, we agreed to revise, and your Rev1 came in on 24/07.

  QT50789 Jaques - our last quote to Jaques went out in December 2025 and yours is dated 18/05/2026. Can you tell me what that one was for? It does not match anything we have sent.

  QT42159 Spoone School - I cannot find our send under that name, but it did go out: Gintare told Vetroseal on 13/07 that the customer had come back asking whether our quotation still stood. It exists under a name we have not matched yet.

On outcomes, the honest position is that we do not have any. None of the twelve is recorded won or lost, and none of the folders has moved into our projects tree, which is normally how we would know. Brandon Estate is the one I would single out for you: ninety-odd messages on the thread, quoted to Elkins on 15 June, and nothing back since. It is not dead. It is unanswered, which is a different thing, and it is being chased by phone rather than by email.

One from the earlier batch that you CAN close: QP65690 Cold Ash. The planning application behind it was refused on 21 May and there is no appeal or resubmission on the council's register as at today, so nothing will move on that until one of those appears. We will come back to you if it is resubmitted.

And on the fifteen you sent in March - you have only ever had three of those back from us, which is not good enough. I will come back to you on the rest of them separately rather than pad this list out.

We are fixing the recording end of this. Until it is fixed I am not going to send you hit rates I cannot evidence.

Darrick Wood: Gleb Saliev 09/07, Adam's reply 10/07, A Plus asked 17/07, Rev1 returned 24/07. Brandon Estate: 93-message thread, quoted to Elkins 15/06, confirmed a legitimate tender by Adam on 29/07. Address, full name and title, plus the whole thread back to 30/03/2026: Adam's forward to jacob@, 28/07/2026 19:54. Cold Ash: West Berkshire 25/01899/FULMAJ, refused 21/05/2026, read from the council's own page (AdminBase lead 7745, worked).

drafts.subject: Unit 1 Eleanor Trade Centre - our price, and what happened in April
drafts.body:
Hello Mark,

Our price for Unit 1 Eleanor Trade Centre went over yesterday afternoon and your out-of-office came back straight away, so I am re-sending it - along with our terms and conditions, which the proposal refers to and did not carry.

The price is GBP 7,975.85 for the four aluminium windows and the door to the ground floor.

One question while I have you. We priced this same unit for you in April on a different scope - six uPVC windows over both floors, at GBP 4,252.16 - and we never heard back. I am not asking you to revisit it. I would just like to know what happened, because we quote for Bradford Watts often and I would rather understand what we are getting wrong than keep sending prices into the same silence.
drafts.evidence: July: issued 28/07/2026 14:22 from estimating@, GBP 7,975.85; out-of-office received 14:23. April: quoted to Mark Golden 20/04/2026 16:23, revised 16:38, GBP 4,252.16 for six uPVC windows - Mary has the file. Both figures are ex VAT and both come from messages that left the building. The scope difference is hers too: April both floors in uPVC, July ground floor in aluminium plus a door.
drafts.must_not_say: Do not say we quoted the same job twice, and do not set the two figures side by side as though they were comparable - they are different scopes in different systems, and the client will notice faster than we will. Do not offer to re-price or to hold the figure.

Dan,

We have three glazing packages priced and still open with you: Archway Road and Weymouth Court from December, and Emmbrook School which went through EstimateOne in May.

I am not chasing all three. I am asking one question: which of them are still live?

If any were awarded elsewhere or shelved, say so and I will close them off our side - I would rather have an accurate list than an optimistic one. For any still running, tell me where they are and what you need from us.

Separately, Kieran and I are picking up Tiverton Road, and the revised figure for Darrick Wood is in hand following Gleb's review - so nothing is needed from you on either of those.

If it is easier, I can come to you. A half-hour going through the list together would be worth more than a run of emails.
